svg.aria-label: A bar from zero splitting band d total, unparished, £2,540.32, into 4 parts: Burnley Borough Council £351.44 (13.8%), Lancashire County Council £1,801.75 (70.9%), Lancashire Police Authority £292.40 (11.5%), Lancashire Combined Fire Authority £94.73 (3.7%). Four bodies charge a Burnley Band D bill
svg.text: Four bodies charge a Burnley Band D

g.title: Burnley Borough Council: £351.44, 13.8% of the bill

Lancashire Police Authority: £292.40, 11.5% of the bill
Lancashire Combined Fire Authority: £94.73, 3.7% of the bill
